name: DownLord release boundary policy
description: Single source of truth for the public release tree: strip list, forbidden candidate paths, required targets, public document overlays, internal markers, link/artifact rules and the staged check catalogue. Consumed by scripts/release.mjs (tree builder, source/sync/public-history checks), scripts/release/checks.mjs (candidate assertions) and the secrets-scanner release-face adapter. stripPaths / forbiddenCandidatePaths / requiredTargets are repository-relative POSIX literals only: no globs, no regular expressions.

pathSemantics.form: repository-relative POSIX; a directory entry ends with '/' and matches the directory itself plus every descendant; a file entry matches exactly one path; matching is case-sensitive and a differently-cased variant of a rule path is reported as an anomaly instead of being silently kept

trackedInputRule: a tracked path that matches forbiddenCandidatePaths is an input anomaly: reported as FORBIDDEN_TRACKED_INPUT and blocks preparation; never silently dropped

directories.basis: release tooling modules and the .mjs release test suite

provenance.basis: every registered licence material must be present in the candidate with the registered byte hash; the registry is read from the frozen commit, never from a second list

publicDocuments.baseCommitForm: full 40-hex commit object id; symbolic names (HEAD, main, tags) and abbreviated ids are rejected
publicDocuments.driftRule: per document: blob of sourcePath at the frozen commit must equal blob of sourcePath at baseCommit, the working-tree source must equal the frozen blob, and sha256 of the publicPath blob must equal publicSha256; unrelated commits never count as drift; the tool never rewrites the registry or public files

internalMarkers.scope: text content of the actual candidate, split into two faces by file extension: prose (Markdown and any other text) must be marker-free; code (source, tests, rules, configuration) may carry a marker only at a position declared below for that exact file. Ordinary words such as Task, plan, spec, review are never markers. Matching is boundary-aware: a marker never matches inside a longer identifier or path segment (the npm package name electron-publish does not contain the overlay directory marker).

internalMarkers.exemptionRule: an occurrence is rule data only when it sits at a declared position kind of a declared file; no directory, file or rule-wide exemption; declared positions with zero occurrences are reported as unused; secrets rules are never exempted by these positions

faces.prose: *.md and every text file whose extension is not listed as code; zero occurrences except a declared prose-term position
faces.code: ts tsx js mjs cjs css json yml yaml toml ffpreset and dot-files (.gitignore .gitattributes .editorconfig .prettierignore .prettierrc); occurrences must sit at a declared position
faces.binary: binary paths and NUL-containing content are listed as skipped, never counted as clean

positionKinds.json-pointer: string values (and keys) under one of jsonPointerPrefixes of a JSON file
positionKinds.named-case-data: string literals or comments inside a test file that models synthetic paths
positionKinds.registry-file-field: the file: string field of an entry inside the ADJUDICATED registry array of the secrets scanner
positionKinds.string-literal: a string literal (fixture root or path constant)
positionKinds.ignore-rule: a whole-line ignore pattern in an ignore file
positionKinds.prose-term: a glossary definition of the release mechanism itself, limited to maxOccurrences inside the named section

localTargets.resolveAgainst: candidate root; a leading '/' is root-relative
localTargets.anchors: github-slug; duplicate headings get numeric suffixes; explicit html ids count

verbatimUpstreamMaterials.source: requiredTargets.provenance registry entries whose transformation is "verbatim byte copy"
verbatimUpstreamMaterials.treatment: links inside those files are parsed, resolved and listed in evidence with class upstream-verbatim; missing or case-mismatched local targets inside them are not counted as candidate defects because the bytes must stay identical to the upstream release; stripped targets and machine-absolute forms still fail
verbatimUpstreamMaterials.reason: licence obligation to ship the upstream material unmodified

externalLinks.deferredPushLinkRule: exact URL under https://github.com/lie-dream/DownLord/ that only becomes valid after this source push; no host-wide allowance; unreleased Release assets and disabled features are not eligible
externalLinks.verbatimUpstreamMaterials: external URLs inside verbatim upstream materials are listed with class upstream-verbatim and are not part of the per-url requirement; every other external URL of the candidate needs a per-url result
externalLinks.evidence: evidence/external-links.json written by the operator: { schemaVersion: 1, candidateDigest, results: [{ url, status, checkedAt, checkedBy, httpStatus?, finalUrl?, dependsOnPush? }] }

staticEntryFiles.basis: electron-vite renderer root (electron.vite.config.ts renderer.build.rollupOptions.input.index); a root-relative script src resolves inside src/renderer/
second renderer entry (rollupOptions.input.takeover) under the same renderer root
esbuild output of scripts/build-extension.mjs ENTRY_POINTS written next to the copied popup.html in the extension output directory; not a source file

linkRules.staticEntryFilesRule: only the listed files get a resolution root or a build-output list; any other html/svg file resolves every reference against the candidate root and a missing target is a defect
linkRules.unparsedReferenceRule: an occurrence of an unparsed reference type in a covered non-upstream document makes all-syntaxes-parsed UNCHECKED (exit 2) with the locations listed; occurrences inside verbatim upstream materials are listed in evidence only

artifactRules.packageCommand: npm run package, run explicitly by the operator inside the frozen build/ copy; never invoked by the release CLI

publicGit.repositoryRole: independent sibling repository with its own .git; not a worktree, clone or alternates user of the internal repository
publicGit.historyRule: first public commit has no parent; every later public commit has exactly one parent, the previous public commit; no commit of the public chain may exist in the internal repository; existing tags never move
publicGit.resultEvidenceRule: one append-only file per check run; never overwritten

evidenceContracts.internal-gate.json: { schemaVersion: 1, commit, runs: { gate | scan-secrets | scan-licenses | audit-todo : { command, exitCode, status, startedAt, finishedAt, log? } } } written by the operator from separately executed commands on the internal tree at the frozen commit
evidenceContracts.release-tests.json: { schemaVersion: 1, commit, command, exitCode, counts: { tests, pass, fail, skipped }, finishedAt } from an independent npm run test:release
evidenceContracts.validation-delta.json: { schemaVersion: 1, commit, candidateDigest, items: [{ id, object, input, canRun, coverage, conclusion, timepoint, evidence, pushBlocker, resolved }] } with every required id listed in checks.mjs REQUIRED_DELTA_ITEMS
evidenceContracts.manual-checks.json: { schemaVersion: 1, reviews: [{ id: public-documents | readme-community | screenshots, reviewer, reviewedAt, candidateDigest, result, files: [{ path, sha256, privacy?, metadataReviewed?, source? }] }] }; reviewer must be a person, never an automated agent
